# RunToMax

> RunToMax turns Apple Watch and iPhone into a real running training platform: race-watch-grade metrics, adaptive training plans (5K, 10K, half, marathon), structured intervals, HR-zone discipline, lane-exact track mode, and a coach that audits every run. Built by an experienced runner. Ships 2026.

## What RunToMax does

- Adaptive training plans for 5K, 10K, half marathon, and marathon, built around the runner's training load and rebalanced when life gets in the way.
- Race-watch-grade metrics on Apple Watch: VO₂ max, training load (acute and chronic balance), recovery time informed by sleep and HRV, HR zones based on lactate-style personalization, and a race predictor.
- Structured workouts on the wrist: intervals, tempos, and progressions built on the iPhone, executed lap-perfect on the watch with countdowns, pace targets, and audio cues.
- HR-zone discipline visualization: a rainbow zone bar that bulges at the runner's current zone — Zone 2 drift is felt instantly.
- Lane-exact track mode: distance accumulates by the chosen lane's geometry, not GPS noise. Lane 5 is 425 meters per lap.
- Four hand-tuned mid-run watch faces: outdoor, treadmill, intervals, and track.
- Coach Notes after every run: explains why the run went the way it did and adjusts the upcoming week.
- FIT and GPX export, HealthKit read/write, and WeatherKit context.
- Optional cloud coaching powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash through a secured proxy. It explains finalized RunToMax facts and is included with Pro.

## Who it's for

- Serious runners who do tempo runs, intervals, long runs, and chase finish-line times.
- Apple Watch and iPhone users who want race-watch-grade training without buying a dedicated running watch.
- Not for casual joggers or step-counters.

## Platform

- iOS and watchOS.
- Ships 2026. Waitlist members get early TestFlight builds, a founder offer on Pro, and a hand-numbered first-1000 badge in the app.
